methodology.source: Local HTTP serving of unchanged repository files; read-only module-scope snapshot probe inserted at the existing test hook.
methodology.realTime: Fresh native Chromium multi-touch held-Forward plus secondary Pause sequence; real animation frames and wall time, without Playwright clock.
methodology.controlledClock: Actual engine imports, canvas creation, and at least one real render complete first. Playwright clock is then installed and paused while the game is still at Ready. Native input handlers run normally; only explicit runFor advances game frames.
methodology.touch: Chromium CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent with native trusted pointer/touch events; records isPrimary, pointerId, capture events, and action-state snapshots.
methodology.legacy: Forced fallback: window.PointerEvent is undefined before application startup, then the same native Chromium touch driver exercises touchstart/touchend/touchcancel.
methodology.webkit: Ordinary mouse, keyboard Escape/Enter, and primary touchscreen-tap checks use real wall time, without Playwright clock. Unsupported multi-touch cases are explicitly skipped.
methodology.captureLoss: Native touch first gains capture; releasePointerCapture is called explicitly, followed by native touchMove to deliver lostpointercapture. This is a scripted capture-loss scenario.
methodology.baselineStatus: PASS means the stated assertion succeeded. For baseline Pause cases, baselineDefectReproduced=true and observedGameBehavior=FAIL_SECONDARY_PAUSE report the existing game defect.

notExecuted: WebKit multi-touch sequences: this harness has no supported multi-touch driver for WebKit.
Physical phone/iPad touch, performance, orientation, and hardware rendering.
Actual OS background/foreground and device rotation transitions.
Children age 10 playtesting, fun assessment, and approved V4.1 visual verification.
This focused input suite does not certify FPS-independent physics or complete route completion.
